manifest.title: Multiplication tables on a circle
manifest.hook: Connect i to k·i mod n and a cardioid appears. Keep going and it grows cusps.
manifest.alt: A circle with evenly spaced points joined by straight chords. As the multiplier slowly grows, the chords form a glowing heart-shaped curve, then a two-lobed one, then curves with more and more cusps.
manifest.author: @circle-mod-n

presets.label: n = 101, wait for k = 51
presets.note: 51 · 2 ≡ 1 (mod 101), so multiplying by 51 undoes multiplying by 2 and the cardioid's chords come back.

presets.label: n = 30, chords not a curve
presets.note: With few points the envelope dissolves into a visible chord diagram. Where does it stop looking like a curve?

pieces.title: The group law on an elliptic curve

manifest.title: The group law on an elliptic curve
manifest.hook: A line through P and Q meets the cubic once more. Reflect that point and you have P + Q.
manifest.alt: A cubic curve with a line through two points P and Q that crosses it a third time; a dashed vertical line joins that crossing to its mirror image, the sum P + Q, while P slides along the curve. Engaged, either point can be dragged along the curve and the sum follows.
manifest.author: @kmoreau.geom

pointer.hint: Drag P or Q along the curve

presets.label: Split the curve: b = 0.30
presets.note: Below 2/(3√3) ≈ 0.385 the real curve has two components. The unbounded one is the identity component, and a subgroup.

presets.label: P on the oval
presets.note: With P on the oval and Q on the unbounded branch, P + Q lands back on the oval: the oval is a coset of the identity component.

presets.label: Let P slide again
presets.note: P follows its animation again and Q goes back to its place.

manifest.title: Four valleys of Himmelblau
manifest.hook: Twelve gradient-descent walkers with momentum race toward the four minima of a nonconvex function.
manifest.alt: A contour map of a landscape with four dark valleys. Twelve dots start on a ring around the middle and roll downhill, leaving trails that curve and settle into the four valleys.
manifest.author: @sofia.opt

presets.label: Overshoot: η = 0.010
presets.note: Momentum turns into overshoot: walkers ricochet between valleys before settling, or never settle.

presets.label: Steepest descent: η = 0.001
presets.note: Paths hug the curves of steepest descent, which cross every contour at a right angle.

pieces.title: Julia sets on a circle of parameters

manifest.title: Julia sets on a circle of parameters
manifest.hook: As c circles the origin, the Julia set of z² + c shatters into dust and reassembles.
manifest.alt: A detailed fractal shape in warm and cool colors with a two-fold symmetry. As a point moves around a circle, the shape tears apart into scattered dust and then joins back into one connected piece.
manifest.author: @fatou.dust

presets.label: c = −0.7885, connected
presets.note: c is in the period-2 bulb of the Mandelbrot set, |c + 1| < 1/4, so the critical orbit stays bounded and J_c is connected.

presets.label: c = 0.7885, dust
presets.note: On the real axis past c = 1/4 the critical orbit escapes, so c is outside the Mandelbrot set and J_c is a Cantor set.

pieces.title: A square wave from spinning circles

manifest.title: A square wave from spinning circles
manifest.hook: Each epicycle is one odd harmonic. Add more and watch the Gibbs overshoot refuse to shrink.
manifest.alt: On the left, a chain of rotating circles, each smaller and faster than the last. On the right, the height of the chain's tip is traced as a wave that approximates a square wave, with ripples that squeeze toward the jumps as more circles are added.
manifest.author: @epicycle.lab

presets.label: N = 1, a pure sine
presets.note: One circle gives a pure sine.

presets.label: N = 40, Gibbs overshoot
presets.note: The ripples squeeze toward the jump while their peak stays at about 1.179.

manifest.title: Riemann sums and their errors
manifest.hook: Rectangles refine from 2 to 64. The inset shows left sums converge like 1/n and midpoints like 1/n².
manifest.alt: A wavy curve with bars under it that are refined from a few wide rectangles to many thin ones, filling the area under the curve more and more tightly. Numbers show the running error, and a small log-log graph shows the error shrinking.
manifest.author: @calc-commons

presets.label: Left rule
presets.note: Error O(1/n): the inset line has slope −1.

presets.label: Right rule
presets.note: The error has the opposite sign to the left rule. Their average is the trapezoid rule.

presets.label: Midpoint rule
presets.note: Error O(1/n²): compare the inset's slope with the left rule's.

pieces.title: The road to chaos in the logistic map

manifest.title: The road to chaos in the logistic map
manifest.hook: One parabola, one knob. Turn r up and a steady state splits into 2, 4, 8 cycles, then chaos, then a window of order.
manifest.alt: Top: a bifurcation diagram, a branching tree of dots that splits from one curve into two, four, then a dense cloud, with a vertical marker at the chosen r. Bottom: a parabola and a diagonal line with a staircase path that bounces between them.
manifest.author: @may.iterates

presets.label: r = 3.20, a 2-cycle
presets.note: The cobweb settles onto a rectangle: a 2-cycle.

presets.label: r = 4.00, coin flips
presets.note: With x = sin²(πθ) the map becomes θ ↦ 2θ mod 1, as random-looking as coin flips.

presets.label: r = 3.82, intermittency
presets.note: Just left of 3.8284 the orbit idles near a 3-cycle, then bursts away.

presets.label: r = 3.50, a 4-cycle
presets.note: Past 1 + √6 ≈ 3.449 the 2-cycle doubles: the cobweb visits four corners before it repeats.

pieces.title: Two double pendulums, one thousandth apart

manifest.title: Two double pendulums, one thousandth apart
manifest.hook: Start two double pendulums 0.001 rad apart. For a few seconds they agree. Then they have nothing to do with each other.
manifest.alt: Two double pendulums hang from one pivot, drawn in two colors, one on top of the other. At first they swing together; after a few seconds one swings off differently and the glowing trails behind their tips tangle apart.
manifest.author: @levien.tan

presets.label: θ₁ = 20°, small swings
presets.note: Small angles linearize into two normal modes. The motion is quasi-periodic and the copies stay together.

pieces.title: The Lorenz butterfly, two runs at once

manifest.title: The Lorenz butterfly, two runs at once
manifest.hook: Two points that start 0.001 apart ride the same three equations and end up on opposite wings of the attractor.
manifest.alt: A slowly rotating butterfly-shaped curve made of looping lines in two colors, drawn from two nearly identical starting points. The two trails loop together at first, then drift apart and switch between the two wings at different times.
manifest.author: @ed.lorenz.fan

presets.label: ρ = 10, a fixed point
presets.note: Both runs spiral into the same fixed point. Nothing is chaotic below about 13.9.

presets.label: ρ = 28, the butterfly
presets.note: Wait for the two colors to separate onto different wings.

presets.label: ρ = 20, transient chaos
presets.note: Trajectories wander chaotically for a long time before settling onto a fixed point.

pieces.title: A Galton board and the bell curve

manifest.title: A Galton board and the bell curve
manifest.hook: Each ball bounces left or right at every peg. Pile up enough of them and the histogram becomes a Gaussian.
manifest.alt: A triangle of pegs with small balls bouncing down through it, one after another. At the bottom the balls stack into bins, and the stacks gradually form a symmetric bell shape that matches a smooth curve drawn over them.
manifest.author: @demoivre.hall

presets.label: 16 rows
presets.note: The tallest bin should hold C(16, 8)/2¹⁶ ≈ 19.6% of the balls, about 47 of 240.

presets.label: 4 rows, Pascal's row
presets.note: The histogram is 1, 4, 6, 4, 1 and the Gaussian is a poor fit.

manifest.title: Lissajous figures from two oscillators
manifest.hook: Two oscillators at right angles, one at frequency 3 and one at b. Count where the curve touches the square and you have read off their ratio.
manifest.alt: A looping curve inside a square, made of interlocking lobes. A bright point runs along it with a fading tail, while two small dots slide along the bottom and left edges, showing the horizontal and vertical oscillations that combine into the curve.
manifest.author: @wasm.curious

presets.label: 3 : 2, the classic figure
presets.note: Three lobes across, two up and down: the curve touches the left and right sides three times and the top and bottom twice.

presets.label: b = a, one oscillator
presets.note: Equal frequencies with a quarter-period phase give a circle: the phase portrait of a single harmonic oscillator.

presets.label: Collapse to a curve
presets.note: With δ = 0 the curve traces x = sin 3u against y = sin u, a polynomial graph x = 3y − 4y³ traced back and forth.

presets.label: Nearly 3 : 3
presets.note: A slightly detuned ratio: the circle slowly shears through ellipses. The curve only closes after 20 turns.

pieces.title: A zoom into the Mandelbrot set, on the GPU

manifest.title: A zoom into the Mandelbrot set, on the GPU
manifest.hook: A hundred thousand times closer to the edge of the Mandelbrot set, every pixel iterated on the GPU, until 32-bit floats run out of digits.
manifest.alt: The black-bodied Mandelbrot set glows at its edge in bands of two colors while the view dives toward a point on the boundary, where spirals and filaments open up, and pulls back out. Engaged, the view can be panned and zoomed by hand.

presets.label: Two latitudes link
presets.note: The inner torus comes from latitude 45°. Every one of its circles links every circle of the outer torus.

manifest.title: Rose curves
manifest.hook: r = cos(kθ) draws k petals when k is odd and 2k when k is even.
manifest.alt: A single bright line traces outward and back from the center of a faint circle, drawing evenly spaced petals that touch the circle. Changing the number k changes how many petals appear.
manifest.author: @tbrazel

presets.label: k = 3, three petals
presets.note: k is odd, so the second half-turn retraces the first and the curve has k petals.

presets.label: k = 2, four petals
presets.note: k is even, so the second half-turn draws new petals and the curve has 2k.
